response.justification: Bogdan brings 15+ years of broad, hands-on engineering across web, backend, embedded and infrastructure, with genuinely relevant high-throughput experience (micro-services handling millions of HTTP requests/sec with async I/O, fibers and caching at Sociomantic) and current exposure to agentic tooling and MCP code generators, which maps directly to the AI-native expectation. Strong TypeScript/Node, craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development), founder-level ownership of an open-source distributed geo platform, and a track record of teaching and community leadership suggest staff-level breadth and influence. The main gaps are the absence of Python anywhere in the resume despite it being a must-have, limited evidence of formal technical-strategy or cross-functional stakeholder leadership at scale, and no stated on-call/incident-response ownership. Worth a screen to probe Python depth, distributed systems recency, and scope of influence.
strengths: Proven high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems work (millions of req/sec)
Current hands-on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP/dev-tooling experience
Deep engineering craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, ownership as founder and tech lead
concerns: Python not listed at all despite being a must-have skill
Little evidence of technical strategy or cross-functional stakeholder leadership at scale
Distributed-systems depth is from 2018–2020; recent roles are product/full-stack focused

key_factors.factor: AI-agent tooling and AI-native environment exposure
